issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that Animal.messageOnFeed() is an abstract method returning a String, but the solution implementation defines messageOnFeed() to return a FeedResponse object (and Goat/Pig/Seal override it accordingly). This divergence in the return type will confuse students about the expected method signature and return value format and may cause mismatches with tests or with the template's expected usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Either (A) update the solution to match the problem statement by changing Animal.messageOnFeed() to return String and adjust Pig/Seal/Goat to return the feed message Strings (removing or repurposing FeedResponse), or (B) update the problem statement and UML to specify that messageOnFeed() returns a FeedResponse and document the FeedResponse class and its toString() behavior. Option A is recommended to match the existing exercise description and simplify student expectations.
